skill.name: context-fundamentals
skill.description: Explains how AI agent context works, including system prompts, tools, retrieved documents, history, tool outputs, budgeting, and progressive disclosure.
skill.summary: Foundational guide to context windows, attention limits, progressive disclosure, and context budgeting for AI agent systems.
skill.author: ChakshuGautam

content.value_statement: Agent systems can become unreliable when prompts, tools, history, and retrieval compete for context. This skill explains context components and practical patterns for budgeting, progressive disclosure, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Explains system prompts, tool definitions, retrieved documents, message history, and tool outputs as context components.
Describes attention budget limits, context degradation, and placement of critical information.
Shows progressive disclosure patterns for skills, documents, and references.
Provides budgeting guidance, including compaction thresholds and token allocation ranges.
Includes Python utilities for token estimation, context building, truncation, validation, and progressive loading.
limitations: Token counting uses rough estimates, not model-specific tokenizers.
The included code is demonstration support, not a full production context platform.
The skill does not benchmark model performance or verify live provider documentation.
It teaches design patterns but does not automatically modify an agent runtime.

use_cases.title: Design an Agent Context Plan
use_cases.description: Plan which prompts, tools, documents, and history should enter context for a new agent.

use_cases.title: Review Prompt and Tool Boundaries
use_cases.description: Check whether instructions and tool descriptions provide useful guidance without wasting tokens.

use_cases.title: Onboard Teams to Context Basics
use_cases.description: Teach shared concepts for context windows, attention limits, compaction, and progressive disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Context Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the main parts of an AI agent context for my team. Use plain language and include practical examples.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Context Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent design and identify which context components may waste tokens or reduce reliability: [paste design].

prompt_templates.title: Design Progressive Disclosure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a progressive disclosure plan for an AI assistant with these documents, tools, and workflows: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Debug Context Degradation
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose why this long-running agent loses important information. Propose compaction triggers, retrieval changes, and context placement rules: [trace].

output_examples.input: Explain why our agent forgets early decisions during long debugging sessions.
output: Identifies message history and tool outputs as likely context pressure.
Recommends summaries at set thresholds and keeping decisions near the end.
Suggests loading only task-specific documents when needed.

output_examples.input: Create a context budget for an assistant with docs, tools, and long chats.
output: Allocates budget across instructions, tools, documents, history, and tool outputs.
Recommends compaction before context becomes crowded.

output_examples.input: Review this prompt architecture for an internal support agent.
output: Separates stable system guidance from task-specific retrieved material.
Flags vague tool descriptions that force guessing.
Suggests concise summaries for older conversation turns.

best_practices: Load only the context needed for the current decision.
Place critical instructions where the model is most likely to attend.
Measure token usage and trigger compaction before performance degrades.
anti_patterns: Preloading every document before the task requires it.
Using vague tool descriptions that make the agent infer intent.
Relying on larger context windows instead of curating information.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps teams understand and manage the context available to AI agents.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Python utilities for estimating tokens and building managed context.

faq.question: Is the token counting exact?
faq.answer: No. The utilities use rough estimates and recommend provider-specific tokenizers for production.

faq.question: Can it help with prompt design?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains prompt structure, instruction altitude, and clear section boundaries.

faq.question: Can it help reduce context costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It teaches progressive disclosure, compaction triggers, and smaller high-signal context sets.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
